name: sshgate
description: Agent SSH to your Linux servers: reads run free, writes need a human Telegram tap.
long_description: SSHGate is a security gate for AI-agent SSH access. This bundle installs ONLY the MCP client half (sshgate-mcp). It is not a complete install on its own: writes require the local SSHGate signer daemon (which holds the signing key under a dedicated Unix user and asks for a Telegram approval), and every target server must first be provisioned with the SSHGate gate binary + a forced-command SSH key line. Do the one-time signer + per-server gate setup from INSTALL.md before expecting writes to work; reads work as soon as at least one server is registered. The security boundary is the Ed25519 signature checked by the on-host gate under an OpenSSH forced command — the read/write classifier only routes.

signer_sock.title: Signer socket path
signer_sock.description: Unix socket of the local SSHGate signer daemon. Writes are approved through it; reads never touch it. Leave the default unless you moved the signer socket.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run one shell command on a registered server. Reads run directly; writes request a human Telegram approval first.

tools.name: run_batch
tools.description: Run a sequence of commands on a server; all writes bundle into a single approval (one tap). Reads run directly.

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: List every registered server (alias, host, port, user, added_at, read_only tier), sorted by alias.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Report signer-socket reachability and per-server SSH reachability plus each server's read_only tier.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check whether ONE registered server is reachable (single SSH dial + SSHGATE_OK probe). Read-only, no approval.

tools.name: revoke_server
tools.description: Revoke a registered server: signs SSHGATE_REVOKE (one approval), the gate tears down its authorized_keys line and files.

tools.name: request_grant
tools.description: Request a standing grant so matching writes auto-sign for a 1-24h window. Requires a distinct human approval; the agent can only request.

tools.name: revoke_grant
tools.description: Drop a server's standing grant so writes prompt again. De-escalation only — always safe, no approval.

tools.name: list_grants
tools.description: List the live standing grants the signer holds (optionally one alias). Read-only, no approval; use to reconcile after a timeout.

tools.name: update_gate
tools.description: Request a signed, in-place update of a server's gate binary. Human approves a hash-bound GATE BINARY UPDATE banner; never grant-signed.

tools.name: transfer
tools.description: Move a secret file between two registered servers, end-to-end encrypted through the gate under one SECRET TRANSFER approval. Plaintext never reaches the agent.
